# Data inventory

<!-- Generated by `npm run inventory -w apps/play` from apps/play/src/lib/inventory.ts. Do not edit by hand; test/inventory.test.ts fails when this is stale. -->

What Ozymandosis collects, where it goes and how long it is kept, produced from the code. Fill the **Google Play Data Safety** form, Apple’s **App Privacy** answers and the privacy notice (`apps/site/public/privacy.html`) from this page.

**Across the board:** all data is encrypted in transit (HTTPS/WSS; matches are DTLS). Players can delete their account and data in the app and on the account page. Nothing is sold, and nothing is used for advertising or tracking. There is no analytics or advertising SDK. **Local (LAN) play collects nothing**: it never contacts the service.

<details><summary>Where each item lives (tables and columns)</summary>

- **Display name**: `users.display_name`, `users.name_key`
- **Email address**: `users.email`, `users.email_verified`
- **Password hash (Argon2) and two-factor secret (encrypted)**: `users.password_hash`, `users.totp_secret_enc`, `users.totp_enabled`, `users.totp_last_step`, `recovery_codes.*`
- **Account id and role**: `users.id`, `users.role`, `users.status`, `users.created_at`, `users.last_seen_at`, `users.crash_reports`, `users.chat`
- **Age range (13–15, 16–17, adult; never the birth date)**: `users.age_band`
- **Sign-in provider subject (Google / Apple / Steam id)**: `identities.*`
- **Sessions (hashed token, device kind, two-factor flag)**: `sessions.*`, `login_handoffs.*`, `email_tokens.*`, `oauth_states.*`
- **Moderation state**: `users.suspended_until`, `users.muted_until`, `sanctions.*`
- **Rating, match count and wins**: `users.rating`, `users.matches`, `users.wins`
- **Online match records (who, when, result, rating change, and whether it used the free daily match)**: `matches.*`, `match_players.*`
- **Cloud saves: lineage, designs, save slots**: `cloud_items.*`
- **Proof of purchase per platform (which stores confirmed this account bought the game, when; a hash of the proof, never the proof)**: `ownerships.*`
- **Memberships (status, period, plan, platform; a store purchase token, encrypted)**: `subscriptions.*`, `users.stripe_customer_id`, `promo_redemptions.*`
- **Player reports (reason, details, and the chat lines attached)**: `player_reports.*`
- **Crash and bug reports (scrubbed message and stack, version, platform, renderer, whitelisted context, optional screenshot)**: `reports.*`, `issues.*`
- **Frame-rate runs (frame-time percentiles, tier changes, device class, renderer; anonymous)**: `perf_runs.*`
- **Staff action log**: `audit_log.*`
- **Not user data**: `announcements.*`, `balance_cultures.*`, `balance_designs.*`, `daily_stats.*`, `ops_alerts.*`, `ops_heartbeats.*`, `promo_codes.*`, `remote_config.*`, `schema_migrations.*`, `server_keys.*`, `stripe_events.*`

</details>

## Sent by the game, or kept on the device

- **Crash report context** → Ozymandosis play service (our server, Linode/Akamai; backups encrypted, off-site). Fields: `settings`, `backend`, `tier`, `fps`, `mode`, `players`, `mapSize`, `time`, `units`, `net`, `log`, `url`, `screen`, `memory`, `lang`. Only these keys are stored; anything else a client sends is dropped. Emails, addresses, home paths and tokens are scrubbed.
- **Frame-rate run** → Ozymandosis play service (our server, Linode/Akamai; backups encrypted, off-site). Fields: `version`, `platform`, `deviceClass`, `renderer`, `mode`, `seconds`, `frames`, `fps`, `p50`, `p95`, `p99`, `worst`, `below30`, `hitches`, `cpuMs`, `tierStart`, `tierEnd`, `tierChanges`, `tierLog`, `unitsPeak`, `popCap`, `players`, `quality`, `cores`, `memoryGB`, `screen`. Sent at the end of single-player and online matches when diagnostics are on; never for LAN matches.
- **Settings, saves, designs, lineage, measured runs, sign-in token** → The player’s own device only (never sent). Fields: `efl.settings`, `efl.save.*`, `efl.meta.*`, `efl.designs`, `efl.designs.gone`, `efl.profile`, `efl.cloud`, `efl.cloud.previous`, `efl.news.dismissed`, `efl.perf.runs`, `efl.session`, `efl.agegate`. Stored on the device. Saves and designs sync to the account only when the player signs in.
- **IP address (transient)** → Ozymandosis play service (our server, Linode/Akamai; backups encrypted, off-site); Cloudflare Turnstile (sign-up bot check, when enabled). Fields: `connection`. Needed to connect; not stored. Request logs record a keyed pseudonym of the account instead (D16); the web server drops client addresses; the TURN relay logs nothing. Online matches are relayed so players never see each other’s address (D19). LAN matches never reach the service.

## Third-party code in the apps

| Library | What it collects |
|---|---|
| `com.android.billingclient:billing` | Google Play Billing: Google processes the purchase and holds the payment method (Financial info: Purchase history, shared with Google as the payment processor). |
| `com.google.android.play:integrity` | Play Integrity: Google checks that this copy came from Play and that the Google account holds a licence, and returns a verdict to our server (App info and performance: Diagnostics; Google’s own policy applies). |
| `androidx.appcompat:appcompat` | Nothing. |
| `androidx.coordinatorlayout:coordinatorlayout` | Nothing. |
| `androidx.core:core-splashscreen` | Nothing. |
| `@capacitor/core` | Nothing (the native bridge). |
| `@capacitor/app` | Nothing. |
| `@capacitor/browser` | Nothing (opens the system browser for sign-in and the account page). |
| `@capacitor/haptics` | Nothing. |
| `@capacitor/screen-orientation` | Nothing. |
| `@capacitor/share` | Nothing (opens the system share sheet for the lobby join code). |
| `@capacitor/status-bar` | Nothing. |

## Other services involved

- Stripe (web payments, off by default; memberships are sold in each platform’s store)
- Google Play (Android purchases and Play Integrity; Google processes the payment)
- Apple App Store (iOS purchases; Apple processes the payment)
- Valve / Steam (Steam purchases and ownership checks)
- Our email provider (sends sign-in and account mail)
- Cloudflare Turnstile (sign-up bot check, when enabled)
- Google / Apple / Steam (only if the player signs in with them)

## Play Data Safety answers, summarised

- **App activity: App interactions** — collected, not shared; required; purposes: Matchmaking and the player’s record; Ratings, disputes, counting the free match (one per rolling 24 hours).
- **App activity: Other actions** — collected, not shared; required; purposes: Enforcing the rules; Accountability for staff and billing actions.
- **App activity: Other user-generated content** — collected, not shared; optional; purposes: Sync between the player’s devices.
- **App info and performance: Crash logs** — collected, not shared; optional; purposes: Fixing crashes and bugs.
- **App info and performance: Other app performance data** — collected, not shared; optional; purposes: Keeping the game smooth on real devices.
- **Financial info: Purchase history** — collected, shared with service providers only; required; purposes: The $1 purchase gates online play; bound to the account; Online play beyond the free match.
- **Messages: Other in-app messages** — collected, not shared; optional; purposes: Moderation.
- **Personal info: Email address** — collected, shared with service providers only; required; purposes: Account, sign-in, security mail.
- **Personal info: Name** — collected, not shared; optional; purposes: Shown to other players; account.
- **Personal info: Other info** — collected, not shared; required; purposes: Account security; Chat safety for younger players; the 13+ rule.
- **Personal info: User IDs** — collected, shared with service providers only; required; purposes: Account, preferences; Sign-in with that provider; Keeping the player signed in; one-time links.
- **Location, contacts, photos, files, calendar, health, device identifiers, web history** — not collected.
